title: The Shortcodes Ultimate WordPress plugin before 7.9.1 does not escape the error message returned when a remote feed…
description: The Shortcodes Ultimate WordPress plugin versions before 7.9.1 contain a vulnerability where error messages from failed remote feed retrievals are not properly escaped. This flaw allows users with contributor role or higher to conduct stored cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks against administrators by directing the feed to a malicious server they control.
